config.normal_route_budget: Original native search count, budget exempt
config.quality_query_cost: Archived encode + decode + quality, with selected ASTC reuse
config.pure_model_cost: One archived final encode + measured batch-amortized model path
config.native_route_cost: Original per-image search_ms; archive-matched cost is retained as a separate estimate

scope: Frozen development validation predictions and archived candidate metrics
calibration_scope: Already-fitted margins from the same validation1000
encoding_count_scope: Projected unique encodes including the final selected ASTC. Selected measured results are reused
budget_scope: K limits all unique encodes on model-routed images. Normal-native routes retain the original search count
probe_preset_rule: First predicted strict preset within a block, otherwise first maximum predicted float32 PSNR
budget_exhaustion_rule: Retain a measured strict incumbent, else last measured PSNR-pass in a locked block, else first measured highest PSNR
large_rule: Preserve the native measured cross-block lookahead before the locked-block boundary check
timing_scope: Native-routed images use their historical Unity search_ms. Model-routed images use archived encode/decode/quality durations plus measured batch-amortized PNG/input/inference/policy cost. The archive-matched estimate uses archived candidate durations on every route
